title: On Chatting with the watchman till midnight
subtitle: 城市生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）
meta: 主题语境：城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）　|　核心词汇：chat　|　正文 353 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 chat 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1948 the craftsman ① chatted with the watchman till midnight without a word of thanks, and every apprentice in the workshop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the craftsman ② chats with the watchman till midnight at once without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ chat with the watchman till midnight at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ chatted with the watchman till midnight before — a line in the ledger for August 1942 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Chatting with the watchman till midnight without a word of thanks, the craftsman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the tool at the far bench, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ chat about the price of coal at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Chat about the price of coal at once and never mention it again.

By 1955 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the ledger, and a new apprentice from the next workshop ⑧ chats about the price of coal without a word of thanks every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bench, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ chatted with the watchman till midnight again when nobody else would.

⑩ To chat with the watchman till midnight, my mother said in 1960, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the workshop remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the workshop forgets, somebody chats with the watchman till midnight at once again and somebody must chat with the watchman till midnight without a word of thanks all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 闲谈（一般过去式 chatted with the watchman till midnight：1948 年匠人头一回这样做，不图一句谢）
B. v. 闲谈（一般现在 chats with the watchman till midnight：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 闲谈（不定式 to chat with the watchman till midnight：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 闲谈（过去完成时 had chatted with the watchman till midnight：1942 年八月的工料簿上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 闲谈（动名词 chatting with the watchman till midnight 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 聊天（chat about the price of coal：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去聊天聊起煤价）
G. v. 聊天（chat about the price of coal：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 闲谈（后段两处：新来的学徒照例 chats about the price of coal，而母亲又一次 chatted with the watchman till midnight）

chat 意为“闲谈”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯闲谈和守夜人聊到半夜”，此处为不定式 to chat with the watchman till midnight。
chat 意为“闲谈”，工料簿里 八月 那行字说明早在 1955 年之前就有人闲谈过，故用过去完成时 had chatted。
chat 意为“闲谈”，匠人说“闲谈和守夜人聊到半夜这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 chatting with the watchman till midnight 作主语。

chat 意为“闲谈”，新来的学徒每个年头都照例聊天聊起煤价，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 chats。

chat 意为“闲谈”，结尾那句是母亲 1960 年的话：要闲谈和守夜人聊到半夜，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和工坊记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 chat 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1948 the craftsman chatted with the watchman till midnight without a word of thanks, and nobody in the workshop forgot it.
Even now the craftsman chats with the watchman till midnight at once whenever the workshop asks.
Chatting with the watchman till midnight without a word of thanks, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever chat about the price of coal at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new apprentice from the next workshop chats about the price of coal without a word of thanks every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother chatted with the watchman till midnight again, and the workshop remembered that half.
